whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The BR01 Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.5★ reviews from 290+ diners in Anisabad, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online table reservations and home delivery menus.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp ordering, special menu showcase, aur table booking integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/br01

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team The BR01 Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, menu categories, and showcase of your top-rated dishes in Anisabad. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual prices aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
